entries.source: 可扩展性和性能（针对客户通用应用及负载）
WR5220 G3 外观及关键组件
entries.target: WR5220 G3 appearance and key components

entries.source: WR5220 G3 提供高性能 高可扩展性并降低成本
entries.target: The WR5220 G3 offers numerous features to boost performance  improve scalability and reduce costs.

entries.source: WR5220 G3 在设计上简化运维的复杂性，并尽可能增长系统的正常运行时间
entries.target: The WR5220 G3 is designed to reduce operational complexity and maximize system uptime.

entries.source: 丰富的系统管理工具简化了WR5220 G3 的本地或远程的管理
entries.target: Comprehensive systems management tools simplify local and remote management of the WR5220 G3.

entries.source: 支持各类管理协议如IPMI 2.0 SNMP 3.0 Redfish REST API等
entries.target: Supports industry-standard management protocols such as IPMI 2.0  SNMP 3.0 and Redfish REST API.

entries.source: 其它物理安全功能如有锁功能的服务器前挡板
entries.target: Additional physical security features include an optional lockable front security bezel.

entries.source: 适配支持80 PLUS白金和钛金认证高效电源
entries.target: Supports high-efficiency power supplies with 80 PLUS Platinum and Titanium certifications.

entries.source: 支持最多 40个2.5 英寸热插拔硬盘(前置最多 24个 中置最多8个 后置最多8个)
entries.target: Supports up to 40 2.5-inch hot-swappable drives (up to 24 front  8 middle  and 8 rear).

entries.source: 支持最多 20个3.5 英寸热插拔硬盘(前置最多 12个 中置最多4个 后置最多4个)
entries.target: Supports up to 20 3.5-inch hot-swappable drives (up to 12 front  4 middle  and 4 rear).

entries.source: 支持最多 18 个 PCIe 标准槽位
entries.target: Supports up to 18 PCIe standard slots.

entries.source: 支持最多 16 个单宽 GPU
支持最多 45 个 2.5”SAS/SATA 硬盘(前置 25 个 中置 10 个 后置 10 个)
entries.target: Supports up to 45 2.5-inch SAS/SATA drives (25 front  10 middle  and 10 rear).

entries.source: 支持最多 36 个 NVMe SSD(前置 24 个 中置 8 个 后置 4 个)
entries.target: Supports up to 36 NVMe SSDs (24 front  8 middle  and 4 rear).

entries.source: 支持最多 48 个 E3.S(1T) SSD (前置 32 个 中置 16 个)
entries.target: Supports up to 48 E3.S (1T) SSDs (32 front  16 middle).

entries.source: 支持最多 16 个 CXL 内存（前置 E3.S 形态）
entries.target: Supports up to 16 CXL memory modules in front E3.S form factor.

entries.source: 支持 CPU 及内存液冷(Open Loop 形态)
entries.target: Supports liquid cooling for CPUs and memory in an open-loop configuration.

entries.source: 可支持3年7*24*4全国上门有限保修服务及安装服务
entries.target: Supports 3-year nationwide 7x24x4 on-site limited warranty and installation services.

entries.source: 采用双 ROM的方式 具备BMC和BIOS芯片级冗余以保障服务器的高可用性
entries.target: Uses dual ROM design with BMC and BIOS chip-level redundancy to ensure high server availability.

entries.source: WR5220 G3 服务器提供以下安全功能：
entries.target: The WR5220 G3 server offers the following security features:

entries.source: 英特尔至强处理器的安全启动功能
entries.target: Secure Boot function of the Intel Xeon processor.

entries.source: 支持国民技术的TCM或TPM2.0 的集成可信平台模块
entries.target: Integrated Trusted Platform Module supporting Nationz TCM or TPM 2.0.

entries.source: 以下物理安全功能，如可选的机箱可锁安全挡板
entries.target: The following physical security features  such as an optional lockable front security bezel.

entries.source: 超大数据存储容量和热插拔功能
entries.target: Very large data storage capacity and hot-swap capability
